_readme: Which model does which job. Read by src/ethoslm/model.py; ETHOSLM_MODELS points at another file.
Nothing here is used until ETHOSLM_MODEL_API names a provider (or ETHOSLM_MODEL_<ROLE> names one for a role);
with neither set every role is staged for the supervising agent, which is the default path.
providers: api is `anthropic` (Messages) or `openai` (Chat Completions, which OpenRouter, Groq, Together,
DeepSeek, Mistral, xAI, Gemini's compatibility endpoint, Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM, LM Studio and a LiteLLM
proxy all speak); key names the environment variable holding the key (null: none needed);
base_url_env names a variable that overrides base_url; extra is merged into every request body
(provider-specific knobs, e.g. {"output_config": {"effort": "high"}}); a tier may be a model id or
{"model": id, "vision": false} for a model that cannot see images.
tiers: per provider, the model id each tier resolves to. The ids below are examples current when this
file was written; check them against your provider's model list and change them freely.
roles: spec (sentence -> place spec, and the voice), plan (every planner level), type (type authoring),
build (part and wave authoring), revise (findings revision), judge (pairwise vision judge). Each is a
tier name, a literal provider/model, or `subagent` to leave that role staged.
Environment: ETHOSLM_MODEL_API=<provider> routes every role through that provider's tiers;
ETHOSLM_MODEL_<ROLE>=<provider>/<model> overrides one role; ETHOSLM_MODEL_<ROLE>=subagent stages it;
ETHOSLM_MODEL_API=anthropic with ETHOSLM_MODEL_NAME=<id> (the types_n knob) means that model for every role.
retrieval: the architecture round's bounded reference acquisition. ETHOSLM_RETRIEVAL=none (the default,
and the honest one: nothing is retrieved and every claim in the reading is marked inferred),
`recorded` (a cassette directory named by ETHOSLM_RETRIEVAL_CASSETTE: what a real run returned, for
deterministic tests and warm replay), or `http` (a real search endpoint). An http provider names its
URL, method, query parameter, key variable and where the results live in the answer, so any JSON
search API is configuration rather than code; ETHOSLM_RETRIEVAL_PROVIDER picks one by name.
